> Hospio Solutions is a hospitality-focused digital marketing and commercial services partner based in Bali, Indonesia.

## Company and market
Hospio Solutions is based in Bali, Indonesia. Its website describes services for hotels, resorts, villas and hospitality businesses, with a market direction that includes Bali, Indonesia and international clients.

## Service areas
- Commercial support for hotels and villas, including sales, marketing, revenue and reservations support.
- Digital marketing and online exposure strategies. The website names Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads and OTA media, including BNSA and TravelAds.
- Social media content and management for hospitality properties.
- E-commerce optimisation and branding, as referenced in the website service overview.

## Topics
Hospitality digital marketing; hotel marketing in Bali; resort marketing; villa marketing; hospitality performance marketing; Google Ads for hotels; Meta Ads for resorts and villas; TikTok Ads for hospitality; OTA advertising; hotel e-commerce optimisation; direct booking strategy; hotel commercial support; hotel sales and revenue support; reservation support; social media management; hospitality branding; SEO and online visibility; digital marketing agency in Bali.
